title: Far from the Madding Crowd
author: Thomas Hardy
summary: Bathsheba Everdene inherits a farm in rural Wessex and runs it independently. Three men court her: the loyal shepherd Gabriel Oak, the wealthy Boldwood and the dashing Sergeant Troy.
readIf: you like rural Victorian novels with a strong-minded heroine and a mix of romance and tragedy.
skipIf: you want a fast-moving romance or are put off by slow, descriptive countryside passages.
